decision_rationale: Genos is presented as a human-centric genomic foundation model pretrained on 636 genomes with a general-purpose representation. The provided text describes sequence modeling and prediction of RNA expression/variant effects, but no explicit decoder, autoregressive, or other clearly generative mechanism.
evidence_snippet: trained on highquality human de novo assemblies ... representing diverse global populations; Genos performs single-nucleotide resolution analysis and dynamically simulates the cascade effects of noncoding variations on RNA expression profiles; predict gene expression levels
